prerequisites: Fresh DOC-029 access Administrator and Legal Team Member accounts with light theme, no timezone and no photo; each is the unchanged control for the other.
Seeded Jonas Weber (Business User) for the absent-control check. The Contributor role no longer exists (DD-023).
scenarios.expected: Preferences persist for the intended user. Administrators and Legal Team Members open their own Portal view from View Business Portal under Personal, with a working Return to legal view link; Business Users have no such control. Another account's preferences remain unchanged.
scenarios.actual: 6 recorded steps passed on 3fa407e3 for a fresh Administrator. Settings in the name menu opened the Personal group. On Profile, Full name saved on leaving the field and kept its value after reload, and the header menu showed the new name. Timezone search Tokyo selected Asia/Tokyo, saved, and kept it after reload; Use browser timezone saved and cleared the stored zone. Email was shown read-only, and Role had Roles are managed in Organization → Users. Upload in Profile photo saved a 64-pixel PNG; a 1.47 MB PNG showed The change could not be saved. Try again. Appearance saved Warm, Dark and Light for this account, Dark stayed after reload, and the session stayed open. The other fresh account's name, timezone, theme and photo did not change. View Business Portal under Personal > View as business user opened the Portal with the Viewing as business user banner and its real-work text, under this account's own email and unchanged role; Return to legal view returned to /settings/app-view. Change password refused a wrong Current password and a 6-character New password with the documented message. Save then changed the password, kept this session and sent a second browser to sign-in, and the old password was refused. Sign out other devices saved and ended a third browser's session while this one stayed. Sign out in the name menu returned to sign-in. Seeded Jonas Weber (Business User): /settings/app-view and /settings/profile sent him to /portal, and no View as business user control or banner appeared.

prerequisites: Fresh DOC-029 access Administrator and Legal Team Member accounts with light theme, no timezone and no photo; each is the unchanged control for the other.
Seeded Jonas Weber (Business User) for the absent-control check. The Contributor role no longer exists (DD-023).
scenarios.expected: Preferences persist for the intended user. Administrators and Legal Team Members open their own Portal view from View Business Portal under Personal, with a working Return to legal view link; Business Users have no such control. Another account's preferences remain unchanged.
scenarios.actual: 7 recorded steps passed on 3fa407e3 for a fresh Legal Team Member. The profile, timezone, photo, theme, View Business Portal, Change password, Sign out other devices and Sign out results matched the Administrator's, and the fresh Administrator's preferences did not change. In addition, a Legal Team Member account that signed in only by an email link (no password) had a Profile without the Password & two-factor card.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and the technical reviewer. It is not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

The work lab is shared with other DOC-029 agents. Seeded records and counts changed during the run. The walkthrough created only accounts and records named DOC-029 access and changed no organisation settings. Nothing was deleted. Two earlier full runs are kept as walkthrough-r1-attempt1.json and walkthrough-r1-attempt2.json; their dispositions (a reviewer script timing error and shared-lab data drift) are in walkthrough-r1.json.
The lab app container runs with AUTH_RATE_LIMIT=off (lab configuration).
The Contributor part of V-C05 no longer applies (DD-023 removed the role). The absent-control check used a Business User instead.
A JPG upload and a non-image file were not tried; a PNG within the limit and an oversize PNG were.
Profile has no photo removal control, so the fresh fixture accounts keep their test photo. Names, timezones and themes were restored.

compatibilityReview.summary: From 3fa407e3 to 57e77e38, round 2 (DOC-029r2 compatibility reviewer (access)) found the article compatible: I inspected the app diff from 3fa407e3 to 57e77e38, with messages/en-US.json; the new 5 MB limit is for the organization logo, and the Return to setup link does not change Profile, Appearance, View Business Portal, password or sessions. I replayed the round 1 V-C05 walkthrough on the work2 lab, and all 14 steps passed, including the 1 MB profile photo refusal. From 57e77e38 to 432dba3a, round 3 found only apps/web/src/routes/welcome.tsx and its test changed. The wizard now goes to /auth/two-factor/enroll after it saves a policy that requires two-factor authentication. Read the article. Password & two-factor in Profile uses the shared two-factor component, which did not change. The wizard is not mentioned.
